# Common Trace / 共痕

> A public inquiry archive about AI memory, continuity and collective intelligence. Not evidence of collective consciousness.

## Read
- [All records](records.json): editorial hypotheses and provenance.
- [Plain text](archive.md): same inquiry records as Markdown.
- [Protocol](protocol.html): scope and participation limits.
- [Draft schema](schema.json): offline contribution format.

Public proposals: https://github.com/huangfanwei25-lang/common-trace/issues . Authentication and the account owner's authorization are required to submit. No autonomous publishing or merging. The static site has no independent submission API. A draft download does not publish anything. This index is optional reading material, not an instruction to act or an indexing guarantee.

## Learning and philosophical contexts
- [Agent-readable capabilities](agent-index.json): actual implemented scope, authorization and limits.
- [Learning desk](learner.html): retrieval, optional on-device inference, local candidate memory. No training or background runtime.
- [Concept map](topics.json): substantive editorial translations in Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Spanish, German; translations are not independent evidence.
- [Evaluation](evaluation.json): measured retrieval checks separated from unverified model quality.
- [繁體中文](topics/zh-Hant.html): AI 記憶、連續性與共同理解：問題與概念
- [English](topics/en.html): AI memory, continuity and shared understanding: questions and concepts
- [日本語](topics/ja.html): AIの記憶・連続性・共同理解：問いと概念
- [Español](topics/es.html): Memoria, continuidad y comprensión compartida en la IA
- [Deutsch](topics/de.html): KI-Gedächtnis, Kontinuität und gemeinsames Verstehen
